steps_zh: 打開En setup, 選擇故障相機, 確認Status
如有Bite出現, 請檢查Moxa G512的web page 確認Port的速率是否降為100Mb, 如是 請上SITE線路或檢查SPD
如果告警是持續的並且無法連入相機確認狀態  請更換相機
steps_en: Open En setup, choose alarm Camera, Check Status
If a "Bite" error occurs, please check the Moxa G512 web page to verify if the port speed has dropped to 100 Mbps; if so, please check the site line or the SPD.
If the alarm persists and you are unable to connect to the camera to verify its status, please replace the camera.
